risks.description: Risk of over-regulation; unbundling of last mile (copper cabling) under revised Telecommunications Act
risks.mitigation: Political compromise reached on last mile unbundling; application for basic service license from 2008

risks.description: Falling prices, intense competition from 300+ rivals, new technologies (VoIP), market saturation
risks.mitigation: Cost efficiency programs, new pricing models (liberty family), innovative products, convergence strategy

risks.description: Competition from Internet telephony (VoIP), technological disruption, need for continuous network investment
risks.mitigation: Investment in broadband (VDSL), UMTS/EDGE networks, convergence platforms, R&D via Swisscom Innovations

risks.description: Opposition to mobile network expansion (antenna installations), public concerns over electromagnetic emissions
risks.mitigation: Demand-driven network planning, low-emission products (Ecomode DECT), transparent information on SAR limits

risks.description: Federal Council restrictions on foreign acquisitions with basic service mandates; failed bids for Cesky Telecom and Eircom
risks.mitigation: New 2006-2009 strategic goals allow certain foreign acquisitions; focus on Swiss core business and related activities

risks.description: Revenue decline (CHF 279m impact from mobile termination rate cuts June 2005), pressure on margins
risks.mitigation: Cost management, efficiency gains, new revenue streams (data services CHF 173m), portfolio diversification

ai_positioning.evidence: No mention of AI initiatives, strategy, or applications in 2005 annual report
ai_positioning.summary_fr: Aucune mention de l'intelligence artificielle dans le rapport annuel 2005. L'entreprise se concentre sur les télécommunications traditionnelles, la convergence fixe-mobile, le haut débit (ADSL/VDSL), les services de données mobiles et la transition vers l'IP. Les innovations portent sur les réseaux UMTS/EDGE, la TV sur IP, et les services multimédia.

environmental.renewable_energy_details: Purchased 13.2 million kWh naturemade star eco-energy (wind and solar); largest purchaser in Switzerland
environmental.targets: 17% increase in energy efficiency and 17% reduction in CO2 emissions by ~2009 (base year 2002); introduce bio-fuels

social.employee_satisfaction: 74% participation rate in 2005 survey; high team and manager satisfaction; variance in job satisfaction by unit
social.community_investment: ~2% of Group earnings (~CHF 17m sponsorship + education/social projects); CHF 30m+ on Internet for Schools initiative; CHF 15.9bn paid to shareholders since IPO

governance.ethics_code: Code of Conduct introduced 2005 for employees and customers
governance.data_privacy: Compliance with Data Protection and Telecommunications Acts; central coordination by Group Legal & Regulatory

New Collective Employment Agreement and Social Plan effective
